My daughter and I stayed at Sirene Luxury Hotel and were absolutely blown away by the incredible views—they are truly the highlight of the resort. What made our stay particularly special, however, was the staff. From Adalet and Dilara at reception to everyone working in the restaurants and beach bar, the service was warm, attentive and genuinely welcoming. A huge thank you to Atlas and Imam, who looked after us so well throughout our stay. We would also like to mention Yaman and all the buggy drivers, who were always available, punctual and helpful. The hotel is built on a hillside, so the buggies are essential and thankfully work very efficiently. However, the location does mean that having a car would make the stay much easier. Taxis can involve quite a long wait, and there is currently no hotel shuttle service. The rooms photograph beautifully online, although in person ours felt a little less impressive than expected. Prices throughout the resort are also firmly at the luxury end—even by five-star hotel standards—so it is worth being prepared for this. Bodrum itself is extraordinarily expensive during August, and in hindsight, this is probably not the best time of year to visit if value for money is important. Overall, the spectacular setting and exceptional staff were what made our stay memorable. The team is a real credit to the hotel.

We stayed at Sirene Luxury Hotel Bodrum from July 8 to 12, 2026, and it was exactly the exceptional holiday we needed. They also managed the buggy service between the hotel lobby, the restaurants, and the beach, which made getting around effortless. The bed and bedding were wonderfully comfortable, and the air conditioning worked flawlessly — quiet and efficient, exactly as it should be. The shower cabin was the largest we had experienced in a long while — a genuinely nice touch, complete with a great rainfall showerhead. Wi-Fi was fast and reliable throughout. The thoughtful welcome gift was a lovely detail, and the nightly turn-down service added a level of refinement you rarely find even at five-star properties. The food and drink selection across the hotel was outstanding — consistently high quality at every venue. The pizza at the beach bar deserves its own mention: truly exceptional. A personal thank-you to Bilal Barlas for his outstanding hospitality; he went far beyond his duties to make our stay special. The beach bar service was superb as well, and Timur in particular made every day by the water a genuine pleasure. We are already planning to return in August with our daughters. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a truly first-class experience in Bodrum. Five stars, well earned.

The hotel is generally nice and the cleaning was perfectly acceptable, but unfortunately the service was far below expectations. One of the biggest challenges was communication – the staff had very limited knowledge of English, which made it difficult to obtain clear information. When we needed to have a few clothes washed, we asked for a price estimate, but instead we were given a form that was difficult to understand. Despite repeated questions, we received no clear explanation of what we were supposed to fill in and were only told to “just sign.” We also never received any price information before the clothes were taken. At check-out, we were met with an unexpectedly high charge of around 145 euros for the laundry. We tried to explain the situation and that we had never been given the price beforehand, but the staff showed no understanding and the situation became very uncomfortable, and we were threatened that security would be involved if we did not pay immediately. An invoice was not possible — payment had to be made by card or cash only. After our stay, I contacted the hotel manager, Mete, who was initially polite and helpful via email. We agreed on a 50% refund, which he confirmed in writing. Unfortunately, the refund was never processed, and all communication from the hotel ceased afterward. Overall, I recommend being very cautious. Poor communication and the lack of clear price information can result in unexpectedly high costs and a frustrating experience.
